LanguageData.DigitalStoragePatch_CoreProjector.label: Digital Projection Core
LanguageData.DigitalStoragePatch_CoreProjector.descri:
Projects a digital storage core (on this map or another) to this location; the bound core is the real storage.
Once built, use the "Bind core" gizmo to choose the core. Hauling items to the projector sends them straight into that core; this map’s resource counter and trade list count it too.
The projector stores nothing and draws no power. If the bound core becomes unusable (unpowered, deconstructed, ...) it stops working too.
